lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Organized in distinct vertical columns posterior to the gill slits; a central column displays four primary high-luminance circular clusters with increased vertical spacing between nodes moving towards the ventral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs, forming a rectilinear grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single linear feature is visible running horizontally across the upper third of the flank, marked by a sharp shadow gradient on its ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Visible high-luminance blobs are bounded within the first dorsal fin silhouette; higher cluster density is observed near the anterior base with more isolated spots towards the trailing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A transition in pattern from fine-grain, high-density spotting on the cephalic region to larger, organized nodes on the trunk; the pectoral fin also exhibits a unique, dense spotting arrangement distinct from the flank grid.
